$meta.name: Mantel Design System
$meta.notes: Every CSS custom property in mantel.css mirrored here. Status colors are semantic, never decorative. Buttons radius-md (8px) with a soft-lift gradient, cards 16px, no visible card borders (hairline shadow ring).

rules.numerals: font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every numeric cell, badge, timestamp
rules.negativeTracking: Display sizes only. Body and small text: 0 or near.

avatar.rule: Hash seller id → pick one of 6 deterministically. Header user avatar uses the navy gradient + white initials.

rules.buttons: default = --shadow-button soft lift (→ --shadow-button-hover); secondary/outline/icon = none (border carries the edge)
rules.cards: card (hairline ring + tight drop) — replaces visible borders

button.naming: 'default' is the canonical term for the focal action (renamed from 'primary' to match front-end)

outline.alias: secondary — kept for existing consumers; prefer secondary in new code

pill.anatomy: fg color + tinted bg + matching ring (inset 1px shadow)
pill.neutral: Use ink-100/ink-600/ink-200 for stalled, non-actionable states. Never use status colors decoratively.

avatar.tone: hashed from seller id → one of 6 warm pastels

segmentedControl.hard: (.seg) single connected pill, brand-600 inset ring + brand-600 dividers, active button fills brand-600 — utility/toolbar filter that reads as one solid control
segmentedControl.animated: (.mt-segmented) single ink-900 thumb slides + resizes on an ink-100 track; thumb measured from each option's offsetLeft/offsetWidth (no magic offsets); transition held until .is-ready so there's no slide-in on load; spring easing 320ms; count badge .mt-segmented-count (tabular-nums, 70% opacity); sizes .is-sm/.is-lg; for 2–4 filter/state options, never primary actions

categoryPill.use: categorical tags (plan, package, product line) — NOT lifecycle/status

tones.primary: brand-50 bg / brand-700 fg / brand ring (.is-primary) — dominant category
tones.secondary: accent-violet-bg / accent-violet fg / violet ring (.is-secondary) — second category

categoryPill.rule: never green/amber/red (those mean status); never neutral grey (reads as disabled) — use violet

dataTable.structure: CSS-grid (.mt-table), NOT native <table>; header + every row share one --mt-cols track so columns align
dataTable.header: mono-caps 11px ink-500 on ink-50, bottom border ink-200; sortable headers .mt-th-sort + sort glyph (up/down/neutral double-chevron), active ink-800
dataTable.body: 13px cells, divider ink-150, row hover ink-50
dataTable.alignment: numeric/currency right (.mt-td.is-num, tabular-nums, ~20px breathing pad beside a left-aligned neighbour); text + dates left
dataTable.truncation: .mt-td-truncate inner block span (a flex cell can't ellipsis directly)
dataTable.rowAction: always-visible ··· (.mt-row-action) at ink-500, darkens to ink-700 on row hover, ink-100 bg on direct hover; opens .mt-menu (Edit/Duplicate/Activate-Deactivate/Delete-danger)

card.border: none — inset hairline ring shadow carries the edge

activityFeed.layout: borderless rows inside a card, divide-y with ink-150 hairlines
activityFeed.bubble: 32px circle, state-tinted (view = brand-50/brand-700, send = cyan, signed = green, lost = red)

modal.motion: backdrop fades 220ms; modal scales 0.98 → 1 + opacity over 320ms (snap)
modal.anatomy: head (title + sub + close) · body · foot (right-aligned actions, ink-50 bg)
modal.rules: ≤1 modal at a time; ≤1 primary button in foot; no scrollable lists — use a sheet

sheetRight.shape: 440px wide, full height, pinned right, shadow-pop, no top radius
sheetRight.motion: translateX(100% → 0) over 280ms snap; close over 240ms ease-in
sheetRight.use: Detail / inspection panel next to a list

sheetBottom.shape: full width, top corners 20px (3xl), 4px grabber bar, max-height 85vh
sheetBottom.motion: translateY(100% → 0) over 280ms snap; close over 240ms ease-in
sheetBottom.use: Filters, pickers, contextual actions on mobile

formatting.dates: Omit the year for dates in the current year (Dec 31, 2026 → Dec 31 during 2026); keep the year for any other year
formatting.toolbar: Filter control (pill-tabs / segmented) + search input share one 36px height; the toolbar's main action uses .btn-primary.is-compact (34px)

principles: Refined & minimal — hairline edges, generous whitespace, type-driven hierarchy
Monochrome navy — brand-600 carries the surface; status colors only for meaning
Numbers right, words left — every numeric value tabular
doNot: No visible card borders — use the inset ring shadow
No icon sets other than Lucide
No #fff → #000 dark-mode swap — re-pick a palette if dark ships
